newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Envoy started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Envoy started as a buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Andrew Burns said in a research report he initiated coverage of Envoy Corp with a buy recommendation and an 18-month price target of $50 per share, up 25 percent from the current level.

-- Analyst said he "believes the company is well-situated to benefit from strong demand for automating the health care payment process, as well as secular and demographic trends driving increased volumes of transactions."

-- The company is an electric data interchange provider for the health care industry. The company specializes in the development and marketing of electronic processing services that capture and transmit time-critical, point-of-sale financial transaction information.
-- Shares were up 7/8 to 41 in midsession Nasdaq trade.
